AE-08 phase 8 sign-off prep: hand record for the 8 jobs the D1 test removal moves (ledger 476, 489, 490 and 498, control and mutant, all `:portable`; hand record, no --bless). Ruling: PARENT-RULING-P8-BLESS-BLOCKERS.md addendum 3, manifest tools/certification/removals/ae08-phase8-d1.json. The paired `--rebase … --revert` run of PARENT-RULING-ALLOW-REMOVAL-V2 cannot run on this tree (40 of 62 baseline watched files drifted and no commit holds the baseline), so the move is proved by hand, as record 48 did for an arm; the --full bless then runs without --allow-removal.

(1) Name-diff proof. The test names of src/lib/portable-browser-playback-controller.test.ts at e78643dc (139) and at HEAD (136), compared as sorted sets of `test(` names (the file has no describe). Missing from HEAD, 6: the 4 manifest entries ('refreshes from the latest old-session position without overlapping sessions', 'keeps the current portable session active when a rolling refresh fails', 'keeps the old session and retries once when the replacement range is stale', 'stops truthfully when a prepared replacement cannot start after old disposal') and 2 renames: 'refreshes the portable schedule before its installed range ends' -> 'hands the portable schedule off in place before its installed range ends' (5933b727, D1; the manifest's replacedBy) and 'W-F20c ... refreshes from the arrangement position' -> '... extends in place from the arrangement position' (5933b727; record 37 already follows that rename in ledger:476:mutant:portable). Present at HEAD and not at e78643dc, 3: the two renamed names and 'B6f5 the adoption seam adapts to the round trips of recent adoptions, clamps, and a late publish moves the next seam later' (581bfe11, D2). So the lost tests are exactly the 4 manifest tests, and the count moves 160 -> 157 = -4 removed +1 added.

(2) Replacement proof. 'hands the portable schedule off in place before its installed range ends' exists in the file and prints `(pass)` in the control and mutant logs of every one of the 8 jobs that runs it (ledger 476 control and 490 mutant checked line by line; the other controls report 157 pass, 0 fail). No removed name appears in any of the 8 logs.

(3) Measured counts (fast-cert --only the 8 jobs --jobs 1, HEAD 5d8ac844, 0 failing; the same 8 jobs ran twice, see the flake note). Controls 160/0/0 -> 157/0/0. Mutants: 476 153/0/7 -> 150/0/7, 489 158/0/2 -> 155/0/2, 498 154/0/6 -> 151/0/6, 490 117/0/43 -> 113/0/44 (the D2 seam test also fails the 490 mutant: a stronger kill, one added name in `fails`).

(4) Kill proof. For each mutant the script compared the recorded `fails` with the measured ones: no recorded killer is missing, every mutant keeps exit 1 and the same applied count, and the only name added is the D2 seam test in ledger:490:mutant:portable. No arm lost a killer and the manifest names no killer (manifestProblems: none).

(5) Flake found while measuring. ledger:489:control:portable failed once in the first measurement: 'B6f5 a refused adoption answers failed and keeps the session revision; a MIDI clip edit is adopted at a seam' (install-schedule:1 against 2), the failure record 37 noted once. Cause: the adoption seam lead is 2400 + 256 + ceil(slowest recent round trip * 48) frames, the round trips are real `performance.now` deltas, and the structural adoption's seam is at or after the retried one's by 1 to 3 frames when its round trip is the slower; the schedule events before the seam then drop out of the install. Reproduced in-process at 4 failures in 3000 reruns (and 1 in 400) with real round trips of 0.03 to 0.17 ms. Fix 5d8ac844: the test fixes `performance.now` at 0 as the neighbouring seam test already controls its clock; 6000 of 6000 reruns of the test and 100 reruns of the whole file (157 tests, 15700 passes) pass. The product is right (events before the seam belong to the old schedule); the test's expectation was incidental to the timing.
